scope: Read-only direct GLB JSON, bone rest transforms, skinned bone membership and animation-channel inspection. No engine run.

actual_face_axis.definition: Head world origin toward mean Jaw1/Jaw2 world origins
actual_face_axis.note: The actor forward axis is horizontal and is not the anatomical muzzle direction.

recommendations: Negative local-X rotation in Neck and Head lifts the head; in existing helper actor-lateral world rotation this has positive sign.
Jaw2 is the lower jaw; positive local-X rotation opens the mouth. Use approx +24 degrees of entry-relative local-X.
Do not replay full roar clip while blade embedded, because it would move the torso and skin contact. Apply only neck/head/jaw pose deltas with the existing preserved contact mechanism.
Tongue is a Head sibling of the jaws. It has independent motion in roar. Preserve initially and visually inspect within opened mouth; do not claim it follows Jaw2.

Root proposed +22 neck/+34 head world pitch minus existing 15-degree chest contraction yields approx 41-degree net lift, making the anatomical face axis nearly horizontal from the measured rest. Inspect actual posed baseline rather than relying on this rest-only estimate.
